limitations: One local host; five counterbalanced repetitions per arm with fixed payload padding of 256, 4096 and 61440 bytes; no population inference.
Retained benchmark workload is synthetic deterministic software, with no live worker inference, model accuracy, comprehension or token measurement.
This actual host-agent audit exchanges and checks a report; it is separate from the benchmark and is not an inference benchmark or model-accuracy trial.
Reporter and checker execute in separate native contexts with shared workspace permissions, not OS isolation.
Host-agent token use and billing are unknown; no cost-saving claim is supported.

performance.interpretation: Persistence substantially reduced this deterministic local useful-cycle wall time relative to the frozen one-shot baseline. Rust admission adds fused pipeline work; its difference from persistent round-trip admission does not isolate wire language or parser superiority. JSON semantic control has the lowest median useful-cycle time and does not use nom wire parsing.
performance.ratio_definition: Median of five ratios paired by repetition; numerator arm divided by denominator arm; decimal strings rounded to nine decimal places. These are descriptive finite-sample ratios.

timing_scopes.cold_create: First create operation only; includes first MCP/session startup in persistent arms. It is not first Rust codec use.
timing_scopes.post_create_operations: Sum of individually timed operations after create; excludes constructor, create, inter-operation gaps and shutdown, but includes lazy first codec use.
timing_scopes.useful_cycle: Wall clock from immediately before create through final status, including cold MCP/session startup, reservation/completion and delivery checks; excludes separately measured constructor, runtime diagnostic and shutdown.
timing_scopes.warm_send: Individual sends after excluding cold session and cold codec first-use samples; remaining two payload sizes per repetition are pooled. Half-nanosecond median is an explicit decimal string.

semantic_equivalence.contract: All five arms retain equivalent canonical envelopes and final useful state: accepted sends, idempotent duplicates without extra message or byte cost, changed-content rejection, exact receive/redelivery, addressed ACK enforcement and empty delivery after ACK. These are retained deterministic fixture results.
